india6.title: Union Education Minister Pradhan says Rahul, Congress exploiting students; CJP's Jantar Mantar protest site draws Opposition leaders | highlights
india6.description: Govt wasted our time, says Dipke on talks between Nadda, CJP team; Sonam Wangchuk shifted to Medanta Hospital

india6.title: Namma Karnataka Sene chief Basawaraj arrested for assault on GBA officials during footpath clearance drive; total arrests rises to 11
india6.description: Police said the investigation is continuing and further action will be taken based on the mobile phones recording and CCTV evidence collected

india6.title: Rahul changed goalposts to end sit-in, says govt.; BJP terms protest at PM’s residence a ‘symbol of anarchy’
india6.description: Union Minister Jitendra Singh, the government’s interlocutor, says the Congress leader initially agreed to suspend his protest if the paper leak issue was discussed in Parliament, but he later raised the demand for Pradhan’s ouster; Pradhan says Rahul exploiting students as a ‘political tool’

india6.title: Hundreds of people order food online for protestors at Jantar Mantar
india6.description: Food was ordered via food delivery apps from across the country and in some cases, from abroad, with instructions to give it to anyone at the protest site

india6.title: Pellet guns, shock batons used against protesters in Delhi; police deny
india6.description: Shaikh Irshad Mansoori suffered pellet injuries, the first known case of security forces using pellet guns in Delhi; police deny use, say public must “verify facts”

india6.title: Wangchuk shifted from Safdarjung Hospital to Medanta in Gurugram after Delhi HC order
india6.description: Wangchuk was brought to the Medanta Hospital in an ambulance at 7.28 p.m. under tight security

india6.title: 21 dead in a day’s deluge in Assam; total flood toll 31
india6.description: The situation worsened on July 21 after a brief let-up, affecting 5.65 lakh people across 16 districts

india6.title: Jammu and Kashmir grapples weather fury for third day, civilian infrastructure massively damaged
india6.description: The J&K administration decided to keep all educational institutes closed till July 26. Most pilgrimages, including the Amarnath yatra, also remain suspended

india6.title: Congress demands action against former Home Secretary over 1993 firing incident
india6.description: The party has also vowed to strengthen their fight against the BJP and bring a change in the central power in 2029.

india6.title: Outbound portability of medical scheme benefits Rajasthan’s patients
india6.description: Over 5,900 claims amounting to ₹17 crore have been submitted by the patients for speciality treatment in States such as Gujarat, Haryana, Maharashtra and Delhi. These treatments included heart stent procedures, heart bypass surgery, cancer surgery, chemotherapy, dialysis and Caesarean deliveries

india6.title: Farmers stopped at Punjab-Haryana border en route to Delhi rally against India-U.S. trade deal
india6.description: Farmers wanted to peacefully go to Delhi and participate in the rally but the BJP-led Haryana government has stopped them by erecting barricades, Sarwan Singh Pandher, farmer leader and coordinator of the Desh Bachao Morcha, says

india6.title: Former Odisha CM Naveen Patnaik demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan
india6.description: Terming the situation “very serious” and “very grave”. he said a number of students were violently attacked and injured

india6.title: Uttar Pradesh cabinet approves free scooty scheme for college girls
india6.description: The scheme will play a significant role in ensuring easier access to higher education for girl students while making them self-reliant and confident, said the State government. Eligible female students will be selected based on merit from the list comprising the top 5% of female graduates

india6.title: Clean energy push is India’s answer to transition challenges: UN climate chief
india6.description: Simon Stiell, Executive Secretary of UN Climate Change, praised India as a “solar superpower”, noting that fossil-fuel-free sources now make up half of its installed power capacity

india6.title: Russian envoy summoned over death of Indian crew
india6.description: The Ministry of External Affairs said that it has conveyed “India’s grave concerns and unequivocal condemnation” over the attack to the Russia envoy

india6.title: KSU stages railway blockade in Kannur
Thousands brave rain and regroup at CJP protest site, day after police crackdown
india6.description: From only about 200-300 people early in the morning, crowd swells to thousands by evening; many first-timers say ‘brutal’ police action made them join the protest site

india7.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi detained after sit-in outside PM Modi's residence; released after few hours
india7.description: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, DK Shivakumar and many other Congress MPs and leaders were taken into custody after a sit-in outside PM Modi's residence

india7.title: 10 killed in Sikkim tunnel collapse; rescue operations underway
india7.description: Ten people died in a Sikkim tunnel collapse due to a landslide. Search operations are ongoing for those still trapped, with aid promised by the Prime Minister and Home Minister.

india7.title: Rahul Gandhi, Congress leaders stage sit-in outside Modi's residence, demand PM's resignation
india7.description: The protest was in response to alleged police action against students protesting the NEET question paper leak and accusations of 'police brutality'.

india7.title: Lok Sabha adjourned for second straight day amid Opposition protests over NEET leak, CJP agitation
india7.description: The Lok Sabha was adjourned for the day due to persistent disruptions from Opposition members

india7.title: Four Indian seafarers killed in Ukraine: India summons Russian charge d'affaires
india7.description: India protested to Russia's CDA after four Indian seafarers died in an attack on a merchant vessel, condemning the targeting of civilian shipping as unacceptable.

india7.title: Ten dead, 3.63 lakh affected as Assam flood situation worsens; Army joins NDRF in rescue ops
india7.description: Assam floods worsened, affecting 3.63 lakh people across 15 districts, with 10 deaths so far. Army joined rescue efforts as rail services were disrupted, tea gardens submerged, and landslides occurred in Guwahati.

india7.title: Bollywood style diamond heist by Indians in Singapore; one accused gets jail sentence
india7.description: In Singapore, one of two Indian nationals involved in a Bollywood-style diamond heist has been jailed for two years and two months after pleading guilty to theft, with the second man awaiting trial.

india7.title: Priyadarshini deserves better
india7.description: Kerala's 'Priyadarshini' free women's bus travel scheme, inspired by Indira Gandhi, benefits users but threatens private operators and safety. A phased approach, like Montpellier's, could better balance social goals with financial sustainability.

india7.title: CJP protest turns violent in Delhi; over 100 police personnel, several students injured
india7.description: Delhi tensions flared as the Cockroach Janta Party's march turned violent, with police and protesters accusing each other of assault, injuries, and detentions following clashes.

india7.title: Andy Burnham becomes Britain's seventh PM in a decade, vows economic reset
india7.description: Burnham plans to implement significant changes, describing his premiership as a 'circuit-breaker' for Britain

malay2.description: വാഷിങ്ടൻ ∙ ഇറാനിൽ യുഎസ് സൈന്യം ആക്രമണം തുടരുമ്പോൾ അമേരിക്കയുടെ യുദ്ധച്ചെലവ് കുതിച്ചുയരുന്നു. 37.5 ബില്യൻ ഡോളർ ഇറാനെതിരായ ആക്രമണത്തിനായി ചെലവായെന്ന് യുഎസ് പ്രതിരോധ സെക്രട്ടറി പീറ്റ് ഹെഗ്‌സെത്ത് പറഞ്ഞു. അമേരിക്കയിൽ ഇടക്കാല തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പിന് ആറ് മാസം ശേഷിക്കേ യുദ്ധച്ചെലവിൽ ഭീമമായ വർധന ഭരണകൂടത്തിനു തലവേദന

malay2.description: മോദി സർക്കാരിന്റെ 12 വർഷത്തെ ഭരണത്തിനിടയിൽ കോൺഗ്രസ് നടത്തിയ ശക്തമായ പ്രതിഷേധത്തിൽ ഡൽഹി സ്തംഭിച്ചു. വൈകിട്ട് മൂന്നര മുതൽ ഏഴുവരെ നീണ്ടുനിന്ന ഈ പ്രതിഷേധം, പ്രധാനമന്ത്രിയുടെ വസതിയിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട വഴികൾ ഉപരോധിച്ചുകൊണ്ടായിരുന്നു. രാഹുൽ ഗാന്ധിയുടെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ നടന്ന മാർച്ചിൽ പ്രിയങ്ക ഗാന്ധി, കെ.സി.

malay2.title: പ്രതിസന്ധിയിലും പ്രതിദിനം 51 ലക്ഷം യൂണിറ്റ് വൈദ്യുതി വേണ്ടെന്നു വച്ച് കെഎസ്ഇബി
malay2.description: കേരളത്തിൽ രൂക്ഷമായ വൈദ്യുതി പ്രതിസന്ധി നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന സാഹചര്യത്തിൽ, കെഎസ്ഇബി നിലവിൽ പ്രതിദിനം 51 ലക്ഷം യൂണിറ്റിലധികം വൈദ്യുതി വേണ്ടെന്ന് വയ്ക്കുന്നു, ഈ മാസം മാത്രം 1034.37 ലക്ഷം യൂണിറ്റ് വൈദ്യുതി ഇപ്രകാരം നിരസിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. കേന്ദ്ര പൂളിൽ നിന്നും കുറഞ്ഞ വിലയ്ക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്ന ഈ വൈദ്യുതി ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുകൊണ്ട

malay2.title: പാൽ ഉൽപാദനം കൂട്ടാൻ കുത്തിവയ്പ്; ഡയറി ഫാമിൽ റെയ്ഡ്, 612 കുപ്പി നിരോധിത മരുന്നുകൾ പിടിച്ചെടുത്തു
malay2.description: താനെ ∙ മഹാരാഷ്ട്രയിലെ ഉൽഹാസ്നഗറിലെ ഡയറി ഫാമിൽ പൊലീസും ഭക്ഷ്യ സുരക്ഷാ ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥരും സംയുക്തമായി നടത്തിയ പരിശോധനയിൽ 612 കുപ്പി നിരോധിത ഓക്സിടോസിൻ മരുന്നുകൾ പിടിച്ചെടുത്തു. കന്നുകാലികളിൽ പാൽ ഉൽപാദനം വർധിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനായി ഹോർമോണുകൾ നിയമവിരുദ്ധമായി കുത്തിവയ്ക്കുന്നതായി സംശയിക്കുന്നു. പ്രതിദിനം 250 ലിറ്ററി

malay2.title: ‘ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിനിന് കല്ലെറിഞ്ഞു, സമരത്തിന് പാക്കിസ്ഥാൻകാരും’; സിജെപി പ്രക്ഷോഭത്തെ താറടിക്കാൻ ശ്രമം, വ്യാജ വിഡിയോകൾ
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി ∙ കേന്ദ്ര വിദ്യാഭ്യാസമന്ത്രി ധർമേന്ദ്ര പ്രധാൻ രാജിവയ്ക്കണമെന്നാവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് കോക്രോച്ച് ജനതാപാർട്ടി (സിജെപി) നടത്തുന്ന പ്രക്ഷോഭത്തെ താറടിക്കാൻ പ്രചാരണം വ്യാപകം. പ്രതിഷേധിക്കുന്നവർ രാജ്യദ്രോഹികളാണെന്ന ബിജെപിയുടെ വാദം ബലപ്പെടുത്താൻ തെറ്റിദ്ധരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന വിഡിയോകളാണ് പ്രചരിപ്പിക്കുന്നത്. കഴിഞ്ഞ

malay2.title: ‘അവനെ ഭ്രാന്തനാക്കി തള്ളേണ്ട, വേറെയും പേരെ കരുതി വച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്; എംഡിഎംഎ കിട്ടാതെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയതാണ്’
malay2.description: കോഴിക്കോട് ∙ ‘‘അവനെ ഭ്രാന്തനാക്കി തള്ളേണ്ട... അവൻ എംഡിഎംഎ കിട്ടാതെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയതാണ്... എന്റെ ഏട്ടന്റെ ഫോൺ കട്ടിലിൽ ഉള്ളിൽ ഒളിപ്പിക്കാൻ അവനു മാനസികരോഗം ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ?... അവൻ ധരിച്ച വസ്ത്രം കത്തിക്കാൻ അവന് ഒരു രോഗവും ഉണ്ടായിട്ടില്ലല്ലോ. അത് അഭിനയമാണ്. അഭിനയത്തിനാണ് പൊലീസും നിങ്ങളും രോഗം എന്നു പ

malay2.title: ‘രാഹുൽ വിദ്യാർഥികളെ രാഷ്ട്രീയ ഉപകരണമാക്കുന്നു; ആശങ്ക പരിഹരിക്കാൻ ചർച്ചയ്ക്ക് തയാർ’: മൗനം വെടിഞ്ഞ് ധർമേന്ദ്ര പ്രധാൻ
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി ∙ നീറ്റ് ചോദ്യപ്പേപ്പർ ചോർച്ചയും പരീക്ഷാ ക്രമക്കേടുകളും സംബന്ധിച്ചുള്ള പ്രതിപക്ഷത്തിന്റെ ആരോപണങ്ങൾ നേരിടുന്ന കേന്ദ്ര വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ മന്ത്രി ധർമേന്ദ്ര പ്രധാൻ വിവാദത്തിൽ ആദ്യമായി പ്രതികരിച്ചു. പാർലമെന്റിന്റെ മൺസൂൺ സമ്മേളനം തടസ്സപ്പെടുത്താൻ പ്രതിപക്ഷ നേതാവ് രാഹുൽ ഗാന്ധിയും കോൺഗ്രസും വിദ്യാർഥികളെ

malay2.title: വിദ്യാർഥി പ്രക്ഷോഭത്തിന്റെ ‘ചൂട്’ ബിജെപിക്ക് പണ്ടേ അറിയാം; ജെൻസീകൾ ആ ന്യായീകരണത്തിൽ തൃപ്തരാവില്ല, ആശങ്ക
malay2.description: പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നരേന്ദ്ര മോദി ഇന്നലെ രാവിലെ പറഞ്ഞതനുസരിച്ച്, നീറ്റ്–യുജി ചോദ്യക്കടലാസ് ചോർത്തൽ ‘കൊടിയ പാപ’മാണ്; പരീക്ഷാ സംവിധാനം കുറ്റമറ്റതാക്കേണ്ടത് ‘ദേശീയ ഉത്തരവാദിത്ത’മാണ്. എന്നാൽ ഏതാനും മണിക്കൂറുകൾ കഴിഞ്ഞപ്പോൾ, പ്രതിപക്ഷ നേതാക്കളായ മല്ലികാർജുൻ ഖർഗെയുടെയും രാഹുൽ ഗാന്ധിയുടെയും നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ പ്രധാനമന്

malay2.title: സെക്സ് റാക്കറ്റിന് വിൽക്കാൻ ശ്രമം, കാമുകനെ കൊന്ന് കഷണങ്ങളാക്കി ശുചിമുറിയിൽ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു; പിന്നാലെ വോയ്സ് മെസേജ്
malay2.description: മുംബൈ ∙ സെക്സ് റാക്കറ്റിനു വിൽക്കാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചെന്ന് ആരോപിച്ചു കാമുകനെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തി, മൃതദേഹം കഷണങ്ങളാക്കി ഫ്ലാറ്റിലെ ശുചിമുറിയിൽ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു യുവതി കടന്നുകളഞ്ഞു. കല്യാൺ ഈസ്റ്റ് മലങ്ക് റോഡിലെ നീൽകന്ദ് ഹൗസിങ് സൊസൈറ്റിയിലാണു കുറ്റകൃത്യം നടന്നത്. ബംഗാൾ‍ സ്വദേശികളാണ് ഇരുവരും.

malay2.title: ഇ.ഡി ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥരെ ആക്രമിച്ച പ്രതികൾ ജയിലിൽ വിഎസ് അനുസ്മരണം നടത്തി; നിഷേധിച്ച് അധികൃതർ
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ ജയിൽ ചട്ടം ലംഘിച്ച് ജില്ലാ ജയിലിൽ രാഷ്ട്രീയ പരിപാടി. പ്രതിപക്ഷ നേതാവ് പിണറായി വിജയന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ പരിശോധനയ്ക്കെത്തിയ എൻഫോഴ്സ്മെന്റ് ‍ഡയറക്ടറേറ്റ് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥരെ ആക്രമിച്ച കേസിലെ പ്രതികളാണു ജയിലിൽ വിഎസ് അനുസ്മരണ പരിപാടി സംഘടിപ്പിച്ചത്.

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝163円台での取り引き ドル買う動き進む
japan1.description: 22日の東京外国為替市場、イラン情勢の緊迫化や原油の先物価格の上昇傾向などを背景に、円を売って有事に強いとされるドルを買う動きが進み、円相場は値下がりして1ドル＝163円台での取り引きとなっています。

japan1.title: ニチレイ 個人情報漏えいした可能性のある対象者に通知行う
japan1.description: サイバー攻撃によるシステム障害が発生した、冷凍食品大手の「ニチレイ」は、ハッカー集団が犯行声明を出すなか、被害を受けたサーバーの一部に個人情報が保管されていたことから、情報が漏えいした可能性のある対象者に通知を行っていることを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: 株価 値上がり 半導体関連銘柄中心に買い注文が広がる
japan1.description: 22日の東京株式市場、半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い注文が広がって、日経平均株価は値上がりしています。

japan1.title: 6月の中東からの原油輸入量 前年同月比で40.6％減
japan1.description: 6月の貿易統計が発表され、緊迫した状況が続くイラン情勢を受けて、中東からの原油の輸入量は前の年の同じ月より40％余り減少しました。一方、アメリカからの原油の輸入量は5.5倍に増えていて、代替調達の動きも見られます。

japan1.title: “夜勤も快適に” 鉄道業界で深夜に働く社員への待遇改善進む
japan1.description: 鉄道各社は、深夜時間帯に線路の補修などにあたる社員を確保するため、過ごしやすい環境の整備や手当の増額に乗り出しています。

japan1.title: プラ容器高値で容器の変更相次ぐ 小売各社で
japan1.description: 中東情勢の影響でプラスチック製の容器の調達価格が高止まりするなか、小売各社の間では弁当で使う容器を見直し、コストを抑える動きが相次いでいます。

japan1.title: 自動車メーカー 完成車の共同輸送を検討 2028年までに実施へ
japan1.description: 物流業界でドライバー不足への対応が課題となる中、自動車メーカー各社は、完成車の共同輸送を2028年までに実施するため、情報共有のルール作りや積み込み作業の標準化などを検討していくことになりました。

japan1.title: ケンタッキー きょうから全店舗で通常営業を再開
japan1.description: ファストフードチェーンの「ケンタッキーフライドチキン」は、冷凍食品大手の「ニチレイ」で発生したシステム障害の影響で、一部の店舗で営業時間を短縮するなどの対応をとっていましたが、22日からすべての店舗で通常営業を再開したと発表しました。

japan1.title: ニチレイ ハッカー集団が犯行声明 「ランサムウエア」攻撃か
japan1.description: システム障害が発生し、出荷などの業務に影響が出た冷凍食品大手「ニチレイ」へのサイバー攻撃について、ハッカー集団が21日夜、犯行声明を出したことがセキュリティー会社への取材で分かりました。このハッカー集団は、身代金要求型のコンピューターウイルス「ランサムウエア」を使ったサイバー攻撃で知られているということです。

japan1.title: 円相場 一時1ドル＝163円台に値下がり 約39年半ぶりの円安水準
japan1.description: 21日のニューヨーク外国為替市場ではイラン情勢の緊迫化を背景に円を売って有事に強いとされるドルを買う動きが進み、円相場は一時、1ドル＝163円台に値下がりしました。これは、およそ39年半ぶりの円安ドル高水準です。

japan1.title: 高市政権初の骨太方針 NW9広内キャスターが与野党幹部に聞く
japan1.description: 「『強い経済』の実現に向け抜本的な転換を図る」。高市政権として初めての「骨太の方針」が決定されました。一方、気になる食料品の消費税減税は来月上旬までにまとまるのか。日本経済はどうなるのか。自民党の小林政務調査会長と国民民主党の玉木代表にニュースウオッチ9の広内キャスターが聞きました。

japan1.title: 政府とアジア開発銀行 水道インフラ支援で基金を創設
japan1.description: アジア太平洋地域の水道インフラの強じん化を後押ししようと、政府はADB＝アジア開発銀行と新たに基金を設け、1000万ドル＝日本円で16億円余りを拠出することになりました。

japan1.title: 「強い経済」へ経済財政運営を抜本転換 高市政権 初の骨太方針
japan1.description: 政府は21日、高市政権として初めての「骨太の方針」を決定しました。「強い経済」の実現に向け、新たな経済財政運営への抜本的な転換を図る方針を示したうえで、財政運営の目標として債務残高の対GDP比を安定的に低下させることを中核に位置づけています。

japan1.title: 円相場 いくぶん値下がり イラン情勢の先行き不透明感で
japan1.description: 21日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はイラン情勢の先行きに対する不透明感から、ドルを買って円を売る動きが進み、いくぶん値下がりしました。

japan1.title: 首都圏新築マンション平均価格 上半期初めて1億円超に
japan1.description: ことし上半期に首都圏の1都3県で販売された新築マンションの平均価格は1億135万円と、上半期として初めて1億円を超えたことが民間の調査でわかりました。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 7月21日(火)】夏は夜に商機！
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 株価 2000円以上値上がり 半導体関連銘柄中心に買い注文広がる
japan1.description: 連休明けの21日の東京株式市場、半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い注文が広がり、日経平均株価は2000円以上、値上がりしました。

japan1.title: 政府 新たな成長戦略決定 “17分野の投資規模 総額370兆円超”
japan1.description: 政府は21日、新たな成長戦略を決定しました。17の戦略分野に官民が連携して投資する規模を2040年度までに「総額370兆円を超える」と想定する計画を盛り込んでいます。

japan1.title: エアコン国内出荷額21％増 “エアコン2027年問題”背景に
japan1.description: 6月までの半年間のエアコンの国内出荷額は、去年の同じ時期よりも21％余り増加しました。いわゆる“エアコン2027年問題”を背景に需要が高まったことが要因です。

japan1.title: 金子国交相 今週24日にJR東海社長と面会へ リニア中央新幹線
japan1.description: リニア中央新幹線の静岡県内の工事について静岡県とJR東海が着工の前提となる協定を締結したことを受けて、金子国土交通大臣は今週24日にJR東海の丹羽社長と面会し、着工や開業の時期について確認する意向を示しました。

japan1.title: 生産地 備蓄米の早期買い戻し求める声強まる 政府は慎重に検討
japan1.description: コメ価格の値下がりを受けて、生産地からは、新米が本格的に出回る前に備蓄米の買い戻しを行い、価格を下支えするよう政府に求める声が強まっています。一方で政府内には、物価の上昇が続く中でコメが値上がりすることは消費者に受け入れられないという見方も根強く、慎重に検討しています。

japan1.title: トヨタ 近健太社長 “開発や生産の効率化進め 稼ぐ力強化を”
japan1.description: トヨタ自動車の近健太社長は、報道各社のインタビューに応じ、新興メーカーを含めて競争が激しくなる中、部品の種類の削減などで開発や生産の効率化を進め、会社の稼ぐ力を一段と強化する考えを示しました。

japan1.title: NY原油市場 1バレル＝85ドル台に上昇 1か月ぶりの高値水準
japan1.description: 19日のニューヨーク原油市場では、国際的な取り引きの指標となるWTIの先物価格が一時、1バレル＝85ドル台に上昇しました。これは6月12日以来、およそ1か月ぶりの高値水準です。アメリカとイランの対立が激しくなるなか、エネルギー輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡の航行にも悪影響が及ぶとの懸念が広がっています。

japan1.title: リニア中央新幹線 静岡県内着工へ 静岡県とJR東海協定締結
japan1.description: 次世代の交通の大動脈とされるリニア中央新幹線をめぐり、静岡県とJR東海は、18日、着工の前提となる「自然環境保全協定」を締結し、こう着していた静岡県内の工事が動きだすことになりました。JR東海は今後、地元での説明会などを行った上で工事に着手する方針です。

japan1.title: 米アップル 日本でiPhoneの販売価格を約10％値上げ
japan1.description: アメリカのIT大手、「アップル」は、日本国内での「iPhone」の販売価格を10％程度引き上げました。円安の影響を反映したものとみられます。

japan1.title: EU 「排出量取引制度」排出規制の緩和などを提案 産業界に配慮
japan1.description: EU＝ヨーロッパ連合の執行機関は17日、二酸化炭素の排出枠を取り引きする「排出量取引制度」について排出規制の緩和などを提案しました。環境政策が優先されることで競争力の低下を懸念する産業界に配慮した形です。

japan1.title: ナスダック株価指数 一時2％超の下落 中国AIへの警戒感で売り
japan1.description: 17日のニューヨーク株式市場では、中国の新興企業が新たなAIモデルを発表したことでアメリカ企業によるAIへの巨額投資などに対する懸念から売り注文が広がり、ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックの株価指数は一時、2.4％を超える大幅な下落となりました。

japan1.title: ニチレイ 来週正常化目指す方針 流通業界の課題指摘する声も
japan1.description: サイバー攻撃によるシステム障害が発生した冷凍食品大手の「ニチレイ」は、倉庫からの出庫や冷凍食品の出荷などについて来週中の正常化を目指す方針です。専門家は外食チェーンやスーパーなどに影響が広がった背景のひとつに、在庫をなるべく持たないようにする日本の流通の構造があると指摘しています。

japan1.title: キオクシア 米で約371億円の賠償の評決 控訴含め争う方針
japan1.description: 半導体・フラッシュメモリの世界大手、キオクシアホールディングスは、製品の一部が特許権を侵害しているとして5年前にアメリカで申し立てられた訴訟について、裁判所の陪審から日本円でおよそ371億円の賠償を命じる評決が下されたと発表しました。キオクシア側は到底容認できないとして控訴することを含めて争う方針です。

japan1.title: 国産AI開発「ノエトラ」 エヌビディアから新システム導入へ
japan1.description: 国産AIの開発を目指す新会社「ノエトラ」が、アメリカの半導体大手「エヌビディア」から、最新の半導体を搭載した次世代のシステムを導入すると発表しました。自律的にロボットなどを動かす「フィジカルAI」の基盤となる技術開発を加速させるねらいがあります。

japan2.title: Investors see pollution plan silver lining in EU carbon overhaul
japan2.description: The plan to tie free pollution permits to investments in decarbonization could enhance corporate accountability, investors say.

japan2.title: In Gaza, a mother’s hunt for water lays bare a worsening health crisis
japan2.description: Gaza is facing an unprecedented collapse of its water and sanitation systems, warn aid agencies, U.N. officials and Palestinian ​health authorities.

japan2.title: Chelsea signs Rogers from Villa for reported U.K. record fee
japan2.description: Morgan Rogers is the most expensive signing in Chelsea's history, eclipsing the £107 million paid to sign Enzo Fernandez from Benfica in 2023.

japan2.title: Boeing asks U.S. to intervene over record EU loan to Airbus
japan2.description: In a June 29 announcement, the European Investment Bank committed to its largest-ever corporate loan — worth €3 billion ($3.43 billion) — for Airbus.

japan2.title: Trump to seek Congress approval for Saudi Arabia nuclear energy pact that lacks safeguards, sources say
japan2.description: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has long said if Iran developed a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia ​would ​too, fueling concern among arms control advocates.

japan2.title: Japan’s trade deficit widens as yen, Iran war inflate imports

eu2.description: Customers will receive posts from Truth Social’s “most influential accounts” in milliseconds through a service aimed at financial institutions and professional traders. The feed could include Donald Trump’s market-moving posts, although the company has not confirmed which accounts will be covered.

eu2.title: China ‘firmly opposes’ UK nationalisation of British Steel
eu2.description: The UK government announced on Thursday that it had passed legislation to nationalise British Steel, previously owned by China’s Jingye Group, to protect the country’s steelmaking capacity after Jingye moved to shut the company’s blast furnaces.

eu2.title: ‘China’s model is flawed’: top MEP says trade pressure could test Beijing’s stability
eu2.description: In an interview with Euronews, German liberal MEP Engin Eroglu, chair of the European Parliament’s delegation for relations with China, said the EU’s market of 450 million consumers gives the bloc leverage over Beijing and challenges China’s claim to global dominance.

eu2.title: The world's most profitable airlines: Record earnings collide with the Iran war
eu2.description: The nine most profitable airlines on the planet earned a combined $25.11 billion (€22bn) in their latest annual results, with Emirates keeping its crown. However, the numbers largely reflect an industry snapshot moments before the Iran war changed everything.

eu2.title: TSMC posts record profit and pledges $100bn to expand US manufacturing
eu2.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) beat Wall Street expectations on Thursday with a record second-quarter net profit, up 77% from a year earlier, while pledging a further $100bn (€87.4bn) to expand its chipmaking capacity in the US.

eu2.title: China is 'a critical long-term strategic challenge', EU ministers say
eu2.description: EU foreign ministers issued a joint assessment of the risks posed by China, warning that Beijing threatens not only the bloc’s economy but also its security, while highlighting the shared ambition of China and Russia to assert regional dominance.

eu2.title: Germany's Delivery Hero backs €13 billion takeover by Uber
eu2.description: German food delivery giant Delivery Hero said it supports Uber's €13 billion takeover offer, which would significantly expand the US ride-hailing company's global food delivery network.

eu2.title: EU pushes US to exempt €150 billion worth of EU goods from Turnberry deal
eu2.description: Brussels is seeking carve-outs from the 15 percent tariffs imposed by Washington on EU goods under the trade agreement reached in Scotland in 2025. The list, obtained by Euronews, includes iconic products such as Roquefort cheese, olive oil and wine.

eu2.title: Europe's biggest company ASML lifts forecast, fuelling fresh hopes for the AI boom
eu2.description: Europe's biggest company by market capitalisation, ASML, continues to benefit from the AI boom after raising its full-year net sales forecast to between €43bn and €45bn. Investors welcomed the upgrade, sending the shares up more than 5%.

eu2.title: Europe's corporate debt ranking: Which countries borrow the most?
eu2.description: Seven European countries exceed the European Commission's benchmark for company debt, but the figures tell a more complex story. Multinational financing, not financially weak companies, explains much of the ranking.

eu2.title: Google gives Swiss Android users fewer search options than their EU counterparts, regulator says
eu2.description: Swiss Android users no longer get to choose their default search engine when setting up a new phone. Their EU neighbours still do.

eu2.title: Brussels warns dialogue with China 'will not suffice'
eu2.description: EU trade enforcer Denis Redonnet told MEPs on Tuesday that the European Commission will act against cheap Chinese imports by adopting "unilateral" defence measures before the October deadline set by EU trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič to make progress in the negotiation with China.

eu2.title: €2.8bn battle on the pitch: France and Spain face off in World Cup's priciest semi-final
eu2.description: Tuesday's clash between France and Spain in Texas is not just a footballing spectacle, it is also, by market value, the costliest semi-final the World Cup has staged, with the two squads worth a combined $3.2 billion (€2.8bn).

eu2.title: China's June exports surge 27% from a year earlier as AI boom drives strong demand
eu2.description: China’s exports accelerated in June, jumping 27% from a year earlier thanks partly to the boom in artificial intelligence, the customs agency said on Tuesday.

eu2.title: TSMC's June sales drive revenue surge of 68% ahead of earnings report
eu2.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) reported a 35.6% increase in revenue during the first-half of 2026, and of 68% in June, highlighting continued strong demand for AI chips ahead of the firm's full second-quarter earnings report later this week.

eu2.title: Apollo hijacks easyJet takeover with £5.7bn bid, trumping Castlelake
eu2.description: The budget airline easyJet has swung behind a £5.7 billion (€6.6bn) takeover proposal from the US private equity giant Apollo, abandoning its support for a rival American bidder days after agreeing to that offer.

eu2.title: Volkswagen unveils four-year plan but lacks backing for overhaul with up to 100,000 job cuts
eu2.description: Volkswagen's proposed restructuring plan failed to win backing from the labour bloc on the company's supervisory board on Thursday, leaving uncertainty over additional job cuts and factory closures. The carmaker nevertheless laid out plans to reduce production capacity and simplify its model range.

eu2.title: France adds a new millionaire every 15 minutes. How does Europe compare?
eu2.description: Eastern Europe recorded the fastest growth in dollar millionaires in percentage terms, while the UK, France and Spain ranked just behind the US in the number of new millionaires added.

eu2.title: 'Digital euro will not replace cash,' Lagarde tells Euronews as negotiations advance
eu2.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde rejected claims in an exclusive interview with Euronews that the digital euro is designed to replace cash or allow the central bank to monitor payments, as the legislation entered a new phase following months of talks in the European Parliament.

eu2.title: Spain's BBVA bank and former chairman to stand trial over alleged corporate espionage
eu2.description: BBVA was placed under investigation in July 2019 for allegedly hiring a private investigation agency to spy on politicians, journalists and business figures.

canada2.title: How hot is too hot to work? Report calls for heat protections for B.C. workers
canada2.description: Researchers with BC Policy Solutions say B.C.'s heat exposure regulations have not kept pace with increasingly frequent extreme heat.

canada2.title: Edmonton’s stormwater system strained after repeated heavy rain
canada2.description: Saturated ground is no longer absorbing water normally, sending more runoff into drains and contributing to flooded underpasses, sinkholes and washed-out roads, EPCOR said.

canada2.description: Authorities say the package contained what appeared to be an imitation severed human hand covered in fake blood.

canada2.title: The number of wildfires in Alberta has dropped but air quality remains poor
canada2.description: Alberta Wildfire says the 2026 fire season has been an improvement on previous years so far. But it hasn't stopped poor air quality in the province.

canada2.title: First Nations chiefs call for inquiry into Ontario wildfire response
canada2.description: The chiefs say some residents were forced to organize their own evacuations and received little warning or assistance as wildfires approached their communities.

canada2.title: ‘Death by a thousand cuts’: Half a dozen downtown Edmonton restaurants closing
canada2.description: Since June, at least six downtown restaurants announced they'll be closing indefinitely because of multiple decisions on the future of Edmonton's core.

canada2.title: Family of missing 11-year-old boy thanks Calgarians as desperate search continues
canada2.description: It is day six of the search for an 11-year-old boy missing in Calgary and police and family have provided an update on their search plans.

canada3.title: From keeping booze boycotts to withholding energy, premiers talk how to hit back at Trump
9 premiers to allow wineries, distilleries, breweries to sell directly to consumers across provinces
canada3.description: Provinces across Canada will introduce direct-to-consumer alcohol sales — a step forward in breaking down interprovincial trade barriers that prevent the free movement of alcohol across Canada.

canada3.title: No cross-border ceremony for Gordie Howe bridge in light of U.S. trade threats: minister
canada3.description: Canada will celebrate the opening of the Gordie Howe International Bridge this week, the federal minister of infrastructure said Tuesday— but there will not be a celebration with the United States.

canada3.title: Police shoot and kill man at shopping plaza in North Vancouver
canada3.description: Jackie Patton, who lives nearby, told CBC News she was having lunch when she heard multiple police sirens rush into the plaza. She said about a minute later, she heard three shots.

canada3.title: The National | Carney pushes back on tariff threats
canada3.description: July 21, 2026 | The prime minister says he is ramping up trade talks with the U.S. as premiers push back on Trump’s threat of 50 per cent tariffs. Ontario’s wildfire response sparks calls for a public inquiry. And, the first group of Marineland whales arrive in their new homes.

canada3.title: Calgary police release map of missing boy's movements as search for Parker enters 6th day
canada3.description: As the search for a missing 11-year-old boy entered its sixth day on Tuesday, Calgary police say they've covered more than 7,000 kilometres looking for him.

canada3.title: Cosby Show actor Malcolm-Jamal Warner's widow sues his mother for $1.2M US
canada3.description: Tenisha Warner, widow of actor Malcolm-Jamal Warner, who drowned one year ago while on holiday with his family in Costa Rica, is suing his mother, Pamela Warner, for more than $1.2 million US over access to a trust that she says left out her and their nine-year-old daughter.

canada3.title: Boston Bar, B.C., residents ordered to 'leave now' due to new, fast-moving fire
canada3.description: The Fraser Valley Regional District has ordered anyone remaining in Boston Bar, B.C., to leave immediately due to a new fire south of the community.

canada3.title: Does it really matter how you watch The Odyssey? Film-lovers are divided
canada3.description: Director Christopher Nolan's decision to shoot all of The Odyssey with IMAX 70 mm film cameras has people arguing about the best way to see the film. But the "best" way to watch isn't an option for many people.

canada3.title: Marineland belugas from Ontario greeted by emotional U.S. aquarium staff after 'unprecedented rescue'

canada3.title: 2 tankers carrying Saudi oil reverse course in Red Sea after Houthi threat, amid widening U.S.-Iran war
canada3.description: Two oil tankers carrying Saudi crude to Asia reversed course in the Red Sea on Tuesday after threats from Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis, as a widening Middle East conflict disrupted shipping through two of the world's most critical energy chokepoints.

canada3.title: Frustration, worry and hope: Canadian businesses brace for the latest round of U.S. tariffs

canada3.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Tuesday fired Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi as commander-in-chief of Ukraine's armed forces and named his replacement, following days of mass protests in Kyiv, the country's capital, and other cities nationwide demanding his removal.

canada3.title: Doctor at Toronto's Hospital for Sick Children charged with possessing, accessing child sex abuse material
canada3.description: A doctor at Toronto's Hospital for Sick Children has been arrested and charged with possessing and accessing child sexual abuse and exploitation material, police say.

canada3.title: Kaylee Hottle, deaf Godzilla actress, killed in car crash at 18
canada3.description: Kaylee Hottle, a deaf actress best known for her starring role in two Godzilla films, died in a car crash in Maryland early Tuesday morning, the Frederick County Sheriff's Office said. She was 18.

canada3.title: Canada fields star-studded team at downsized Commonwealth Games
canada3.description: Canada has sent a star-studded team to the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, but there are fewer medals on the table for all countries.

canada3.title: Beastie Boys' Mike D to play first Canadian shows since 2007
canada3.description: Mike D of the Beastie Boys is set to tour for his upcoming solo debut, Thank You. The tour, which includes shows in Toronto and Vancouver, will be the first by a member of the iconic rap trio since MCA's death in 2012.

canada3.title: Nunavut MP cedes control over firm earning thousands from the government
canada3.description: NVision Insight Group Inc., an Ottawa-based Indigenous management consulting firm, has earned hundreds of thousands of dollars in sole-sourced contracts from the federal government since 2021. Lori Idlout has placed her interest in the company in a trust.

canada3.title: Conservation officers protect beached belugas in Churchill, Man., until tide returns

bd3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bd3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bd3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bd3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bd3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bd3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
